records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

draft.subject: Picking up from our kickoff
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Good to talk last week at the kickoff. I wanted to follow up now that you've had a chance to look around Wrenfield.

A simple starting point: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one project for a real piece of work is usually enough to get going. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to walk through setting up that first project with you on a short call this week "" just reply with a time that suits and I'll work around you.

Best,
Priya
